title: Independent Contractor Agreement
subtitle: Full Stack Engineering Consulting Engagement
summary: This Agreement sets out the terms under which the Contractor will provide senior software engineering services to the Client for the Talent Hub platform modernization initiative.

clauses.title: Scope of Services
clauses.body: The Contractor shall deliver architecture design, backend API development, and automated test coverage as defined in monthly sprint goals.

clauses.title: Confidentiality & IP Ownership
clauses.body: All work product created during this engagement shall be the exclusive intellectual property of the Client upon full payment.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.body: Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing 15 days written notice to the other party.
